# Write Pipeline: Compose, Transfer, Verify

Shell shortcuts are fast until they corrupt source. Prefer safety over cleverness for non-trivial files.

## Steps

1. Author content where string expansion will not damage literals.
2. Move bytes to the target with a channel that preserves content exactly.
3. Read back from the target to confirm size and key tokens.

## Tiny edits

Single-token or single-line changes may use targeted in-place editing on the target to keep noise out of diffs.

## Failure handling

Two attempts with one mechanism is enough signal—switch tactics on the third try.

## Pair with checks

After the bytes land, run the narrowest check that exercises the change, then widen if the task demands.
